product.name: Monoprice Decor Insert with Flexible Opening White
product.description: DataComm Electronics' patented Decor Insert with Flexible Opening is used to install low voltage cables behind your HDTV, amplifier, or other audio or video devices. The Decor Insert with Flexible Opening is designed to be installed into a low voltage mounting bracket (sold separately) that is installed into the wall.Features: Low‑profile design fits behind the industry's thinnest mounts and TVsConceal multiple low voltage cables behind your flat panel TVEasily holds up to 4 cablesFlexible opening helps keeps low‑voltage pass‑through area coveredPerfect for eliminating connections at the wallAvailable in 4 colors: black, ivory, lite almond, whiteQuick and easy to installMounts to a standard low‑voltage mounting ring, old work ring, or mud ringSupport Files: Quick Installation Guide (Aug 7, 2025)Sales Sheet (Aug 7, 2025)Tech Drawing (Aug 7, 2025)Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
